description: This file defines the 'Coroutine' class in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, which implements a generator-based promise pattern allowing asynchronous code to be written in a sequential style. It includes methods for creating, managing, and controlling coroutine execution, handling promise resolution/rejection, and managing generator flow.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: A final class implementing PromiseInterface that manages a generator-based asynchronous workflow, allowing generator functions to be converted into promises that resolve when the generator completes. It facilitates sequential async calls, handling promise resolution, rejection, and cancellation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Coroutine instance with a generator function, setting up internal promise management and starting the generator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create and start a new Coroutine instance from a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection callbacks to the internal promise and returns a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection callback to the internal promise, returning a new promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to settle and optionally unwraps the value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the internal promise.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the internal promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the internal promise with a given reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current promise and the overall coroutine.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Progresses the generator by handling the yielded promise or value, setting up success and failure handlers.

methods.name: _handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful resolution of the current promise, advancing the generator or resolving the main promise.

methods.name: _handleFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of the current promise, throwing an exception into the generator to resume or rejecting the main promise.
